facts.fact: African ministers in charge of telecoms, ICT and digital economy adopted the Algiers Declaration on fair, safe and responsible digital platforms at Algiers on 6-8 December 2025, drafted under the African Telecommunications Union, with Algeria's ICT minister speaking for it; it is to go to the African Union for adoption.

facts.fact: Smart Africa's CEO and Algeria's Minister of Posts and Telecommunications met in Geneva to discuss the Africa AI Council and Algeria's participation in the Smart Market Initiative; no date of the meeting is given, so the published date 2026-07-13 is used.

At the fourth session of the Algerian-Tunisian Joint Technical Commission on communications and ICT cooperation, held in Tunisia and led by Algeria's minister, the two governments agreed several joint projects on connectivity, postal and telecom modernisation and digital innovation; no event date is given, so the published date 2026-06-09 is used.
